risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The machine may not accept A3 paper or may have a damaged A3 tray.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with an A3-sized document inserted.

risks.risk: The internal toner and drum may be empty or degraded despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner and drum levels from the machine's display or a service report.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new drum and toner set

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the model name and specification plate, usually on the back or side of the machine.
Video of the machine powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the machine with an A3-sized document inside.
Photo of the toner and drum levels on the machine's display.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
